subject: Re: Chain of custody and third-party ownership for inference runtime
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@optimed.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@optimed.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Chain of custody and third-party ownership for inference runtime

Hi Kimberly,

Quick intro — I’m Samantha Lee from OptiMed’s vendor security team. We’re kicking off a security review ahead of a procurement decision for inference infrastructure and need to validate a few things about Redwood’s runtime dependencies and custody. High-level asks:

- A current list of third-party components (libraries + managed services) used by the hosted inference runtime and any sidecar/agent processes.
- Which of those components are under Redwood’s operational control vs. subcontracted to downstream vendors (KMS, telemetry, model hosting).
- KMS residency/ownership and whether customer keys can be escrowed or require on-prem HSM.
- SOC 2 or SIG mapping covering the runtime (we can accept a redacted SOC 2 report).

We’re not trying to be onerous — just need a short intake package so our procurement and infosec teams can scope an assessment. Can you provide a short roster + timeline (2–3 bullets) and a Drive link for artifacts? If we need to sign an NDA first, let us know.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Vendor Security, OptiMed Analytics
Samantha.Lee@optimed.com

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@optimed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Chain of custody and third-party ownership for inference runtime

Thanks for the clear ask, Samantha — and welcome. I’ll own the intake from our side. High level response and next steps:

1) What we’ll provide (short package within 3 business days):
   - Redacted subprocessor roster (CSV) listing vendor role, region, data access scope.
   - SOC 2 summary and redacted report pages showing controls relevant to runtime.
   - KMS ownership/residency statement + options for customer-managed keys (KMS integration guide).
   - SBOM-lite for inference sidecar and a mapping of which components are actively maintained by Redwood vs. third parties.

2) Controls & custody notes:
   - Customer data is logically separated; default KMS is a Redwood-managed key in our cloud region (we offer Bring Your Own Key via AWS KMS/CloudHSM; on-prem HSM integrations available for Private offerings).
   - Telemetry and traces are processed through a telemetry vendor — we can provide sampling/retention configs and a proof of residency.

3) Timeline & ask:
   - We’ll share the initial package by Tue, 2026-09-07 EOD PT.
   - If you’d like full SOC 2 or CAIQ mapping, please confirm an NDA; redacted artifacts available without NDA.
   - Proposed 30-minute sync on Wed 2026-09-08 to walk the package and answer questions.

I’ve looped Marissa (security evidence lead) and Ben (account lead) to align on artifacts and commercial considerations. If an NDA is required, Ben can coordinate.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood_kms_roster.csv, redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf, inference_sidecar_sbom.json

---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@optimed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@optimed.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Chain of custody and third-party ownership for inference runtime

Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround plan. NDA: OptiMed has a standard mutual NDA (I can send a link) but redacted artifacts are fine for now. Two clarifications before your package:

- For the SBOM-lite: can you indicate which listed components are used at inference-time (hot path) vs. deploy-time only (build tooling)? We only need runtime exposure for the first review.
- For KMS: confirmation that customer-managed keys support key deletion/log export requests (we need to know if key lifecycle operations are possible without Redwood intervention).

Please send the Drive link when ready and I’ll route artifacts to procurement and platform security. Wed 09/08 10:00 PT works for a quick sync — I’ll hold that slot tentatively.

Best,
Samantha
